name: Kasukabe Kanon
source:
Favorite cake: Her dad's Sachertorte

Kamiogi Academy second-year and the proud new owner of Marshmallow Tree. A perky idealist, her relentless positivity can also read as plain airheaded at times. While not the most naturally gifted at running a business, her smile and straightforward way of warming up to others never fail to win her new fans. Ever ready to lend a helping hand, lost cats and dogs are such a soft spot for her that she has a habit of bringing strays into the shop. In fact, she even "adopts" the [url=/c62174]protagonist[/url] after finding him collapsed and homeless in a nearby park...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1369790/Marshmallow_All_the_Way_Home/]Steam[/url]]
